limitations: Exact asymptotic hop-count variance applies only to a single vacancy on a finite homogeneous-lane-change cylinder. Sharp lane-layout bounds require two distinct rates of equal multiplicity; they are not statements about arbitrary-density traffic, single-bond current noise, or a thermodynamic phase transition.
scientific_integrity: Complete finite-dimensional analytical argument and exact rational reproducibility checks are supplied. Literature similarity and originality remain subject to independent verification; there is no independent audit or external proof certification.
title: Sharp lane-layout bounds for counting noise in a one-vacancy exclusion cylinder
